t: No Room For Error/In the Hands of the Amazing Race Gods
d: After traveling to seven countries and 17 cities, one team will be crowned the winner.
Teams begin their adventure from Times Square in New York City, where host Phil Keoghan introduces a new game-changing element, "The Save."

t: When You Gotta Go, You Gotta Go
d: The Race continues through London, England, where the Express Pass is on the line, but several teams' hopes of a first-place finish are capsized while boating in a punt in Oxford.
The Race makes its first-ever visit to the Shetland Islands in Scotland, where teams must corral an unruly flock of sheep down a winding obstacle course.
When tasked with a painstaking Detour, the Dentists face the realization that they may need to use "The Save." Meanwhile, one team's lack of communication leads to a massive meltdown on the mat.
With a double U-turn looming, emotions run high when two teams accuse each other of playing dirty.

t: I Feel Like I Just Kissed A Goat
d: Racers struggle on a frightening Road Block when they're suspended high above the Atlas Mountains.
